Medical document allocation, automated by Samantha File every inbound email, fax and scan with zero errors or manual handling. Samantha Smart Medical Document Allocations Phone and booking management, automated by Veronica Answer inbound and outbound calls 24/7, without ever putting a patient on hold. Veronica Phone and booking management Have a workflow you want automated? We’ll build the agent for it. Fully compliant ISO27001 certified. Growing Groups Superclinics Other Select Brands Automate the admin and prioritise your people Care GP is a Sydney-based health-tech company that develops purpose-built, fully compliant and easily integrated AI tools for Australian healthcare providers.
